name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body
benefit: - ₹ 25,000/- to the nominee of the Migrant Worker.
_eligibility_text:
> **For registration as a Migrant Worker:** - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicant’s age should be between 18-60 years. - The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed/ likely to be employed in any State/Union Territories other than the state of West Bengal/ Outside India.
> **For the application of Welfare Scheme:** - The beneficiary should be a nominee i.e., a person nominated by the registered Migrant Worker from his/ her family. - The migrant worker should have lost his/her life due to death during the course of employment outside the State of West Bengal.
